belief_update: At work, I know people think I'm just not pulling my weight, and if they found out I was struggling with something deeper, it would confirm what they already suspect. Away from work, I sometimes feel like this is just something that happens to me, not something I am. I don’t tell anyone how bad it really gets, not even the people who might understand. I don’t believe I deserve help because I don’t see my pain as real. I hide it because I’m afraid of being seen as weak or unreliable. I don’t know if anyone would actually treat me differently if they knew, but I know I’d feel less alone if I could let someone in. I keep most of it locked away, even from myself.
